method.kinematics: KeyW injection and synchronous execution of the production capsule for 1.5 s at station and 15 s/lake, 60 Hz, geometry only.

groundVisible.name: art-a-street
groundVisible.method: Downward 5m segment from fixed eye, upward triangle normal y >=0.45, scene-visible material in station/city. Terrain and Petalwake town use their own height queries. CPU geometry cannot evaluate per-fragment shader discard.
